prompt: Which reads a full line of text from the user, handling the Scanner newline issue correctly?
choices: int ignored = sc.nextInt(); String line = sc.nextLine();
explanation: When reading only Strings (not mixing nextInt()/nextDouble() first), sc.nextLine() works correctly. It reads the entire line including spaces, stopping at the newline. sc.next() only reads a single whitespace-delimited token, so it misses the rest of the line.
